findings.title: Direct provider LLM API invocations bypass model router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral reading raw environment API keys rather than utilizing model router

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model routing, failover management, cost tracking, and telemetry across intelligence tasks.

findings.expected_benefit: Provides visibility into routing failures and enables latency analysis and debugging.
